gamerule.filorosso.length.description: How many blocks two soulmates can be apart.
gamerule.filorosso.events.description: Every now and then something happens to every thread (short thread, chain, swap...).
gamerule.filorosso.event_minutes.descrip: How often a new event comes.
gamerule.filorosso.revive_seconds.descri: How long a "dead" player stays on the ground before really dying (0 = never).
gamerule.filorosso.servants.description: At night Recisione's Unpaired come to cut the threads.
gamerule.filorosso.thread_hits.descripti: A taut thread hurts the mobs it sweeps through.
death.attack.filorosso.thread: %1$s was whipped by a red thread
death.attack.filorosso.abandoned: %1$s stayed on the ground and nobody came
death.attack.filorosso.abandoned.player: %1$s waited for %2$s, who did not come in time
death.attack.filorosso.storm: %1$s was struck by lightning running along their thread
death.attack.filorosso.storm.player: %1$s was struck by lightning along their thread while fleeing %2$s
filorosso.choice.title: The Red Thread of Fate
filorosso.choice.subtitle: Choose who to tie yourself to. If they choose you too, the thread ties you at once.
filorosso.choice.empty: Nobody else is here yet: wait for your friends!
filorosso.choice.hint: You can open this screen again with %s
filorosso.choice.tip.free: Ask %s to be tied to you
filorosso.choice.tip.accept: %s chose you: click to say yes!
filorosso.proposal.title: A proposal
filorosso.proposal.text: wants to be tied to you by the red thread of fate
filorosso.breakup.title: Breaking up
filorosso.breakup.text2: If you agree the thread snaps and you are both single again.
filorosso.couple.title: Your couple
filorosso.hud.hanging: Hold %s to climb up the thread
filorosso.hud.jealous: Jealousy! Someone is too close to %s
filorosso.hud.revive_how: Stay crouched (%s) or hold %s on them
filorosso.level.unlock.5: Soulmates: the thread shines and hits harder
filorosso.ability.gift_weak: You have too few hearts to give
filorosso.type.elastic.desc: The thread stretches up to one and a half times, then pulls you back like a rubber band.
filorosso.type.fire.desc: The thread sets the mobs it touches on fire, and close together you do not fear fire.
filorosso.type.magnet.desc: You attract each other, and Pull recharges in half the time.
filorosso.type.jealous.desc: If someone gets too close to your other half, the thread drags you there and you see them through walls.
filorosso.type.shield.desc: Close together (within 4 blocks) you take a third less damage.
filorosso.event.short.desc: For 3 minutes the thread is only 3 blocks long.
filorosso.event.chain.desc: For 3 minutes every couple is tied into one single chain.
filorosso.event.freedom.desc: For 3 minutes the thread disappears: go where you like, it will find you.
filorosso.event.swap.desc: For 3 minutes fate ties everybody to someone else's partner.
filorosso.event.romance.desc: For 5 minutes affinity grows three times faster.
filorosso.event.quarrel.desc: For 2 minutes the thread pushes you apart when you are too close.
filorosso.event.storm.desc: For 2 minutes lightning runs along the threads out in the open: take cover!
filorosso.challenge.catches: Save your partner from a fall %s times
filorosso.msg.proposed: You asked %s to be tied to you. Wait for the answer...
filorosso.msg.proposal: %s wants to be tied to you by the red thread! Press J if you closed the screen.
filorosso.msg.expired: That proposal is no longer valid.
filorosso.msg.broke_up: %s and %s broke up. The thread snapped.
filorosso.msg.breakup_offline: Your soulmate is not online: you both have to agree.
filorosso.msg.fate: The fate of this session is: %s
filorosso.msg.cut: The thread was cut! It ties again in %s seconds
filorosso.msg.reached: %s flew to you along the thread
filorosso.msg.downed: %s is down! %s has %s seconds to revive them.
filorosso.msg.respawn_partner: The thread brought you back to %s
filorosso.msg.boss_night: The Broken Heart only works at night, in the Overworld.
filorosso.msg.boss_arrived: A bell. Recisione is made of the threads of every couple that ever broke. Only couple hits really hurt it.
filorosso.msg.boss_hint: Alone you cannot even scratch it. Hit it together.
filorosso.msg.boss_grab: A hand from the ground tears you away from your partner.
filorosso.msg.boss_beaten: Recisione comes apart. The threads it was made of turn back into hearts.
filorosso.msg.boss_phase3: It opens up. It looks at you from everywhere.
filorosso.title.bonded.sub: You and %s, joined by the red thread
filorosso.title.partner_downed.sub: Run and crouch next to them to revive them
filorosso.command.you_single: You have no soulmate yet: choose one on the screen (J key).
filorosso.command.event_failed: Couples must be online (chain and swap: at least two)
filorosso.command.unknown_attack: Unknown attack: %s (colpo, radici, missili, presa, campana, salto)
subtitles.filorosso.bond: The red thread ties two hearts
